stack.nuxt: ^4.0.0 (package.json range; not installed, not measured resolved)
stack.tailwind: none (Nuxt UI v4 theme only; no direct tailwindcss dep)
stack.notes: package name is @loganrenz/earthdata-viewer, not @narduk-enterprises/*. Zero narduk-libs (narduk-core/auth/analytics/seo/ai/ui/charts/mapkit-nuxt) dependencies or modules registered. Vendors @narduk-enterprises/geogrid-web and @narduk-enterprises/narduk-mapkit as local file: tarballs (vendor/), a different, non-Nuxt package pair unrelated to narduk-mapkit-nuxt's AppMapKit.

local_reimplementations.name: PlaybackView.client.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Single-file client-only orchestrator: catalog/series/grid fetch, temporal frame cache, stretch state, all playback wiring. Not a generic pattern; too domain-specific to extract, but its size is itself a maintainability finding.

local_reimplementations.name: LayerControlPanel.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Composes Nuxt UI USelect/USlider/UButton/UBadge directly (not raw HTML) into a domain control panel; layout/composition itself is hand-rolled, primitives are not.

local_reimplementations.name: StretchControl.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Dual-ended value-range stretch control with mode tabs; conceptually close to a level/band instrument (narduk-ui NsLevelWell/NsRangeBar cover single-band freshness display, not an editable dual-handle stretch, so not a strict duplicate).

local_reimplementations.name: PlaybackTransport.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Play/pause/scrub transport bar; no narduk-libs equivalent exists.

local_reimplementations.name: RampLegend.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Color-ramp gradient legend with tick labels over a value range. Closest conceptual sibling in narduk-libs is NsRangeBar (narduk-ui instrument) but that is a freshness/band classifier, not a continuous color ramp; worth a design-system look, not a direct swap.

local_reimplementations.name: GridInspectPanel.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Readout panel for a clicked grid cell's value; small stat-readout shape, similar in spirit to NsReadoutTile but single-value not tile-styled.

local_reimplementations.name: MobileControlDrawer.vue
local_reimplementations.notes: Mobile bottom-drawer wrapper around the desktop control panels.

status_chip_badge.notes: Uses Nuxt UI UBadge directly (line 133) for a 'selected product' marker, not a hand-rolled badge.

kpi_stat_tile.notes: Single-value readout on grid click; not a multi-tile KPI row.

form_field_patterns.notes: USelect/USlider-based dataset/layer/companion pickers; composes Nuxt UI primitives, hand-rolled layout/grouping.

date_time_format.notes: Dedicated date formatting util for playback frame timestamps.

layout_shell_nav.notes: Hand-rolled shell/layout logic; app does not use a narduk-core layer shell (LayerAppShell etc.) since it has zero narduk-core dependency.

map_wrapper.notes: Custom map engine abstraction over Leaflet/MapKit (app/map/leafletEngine.ts, mapkitEngine.ts), not narduk-mapkit-nuxt's AppMapKit component.

defect_history.summary: Simplify the viewer configurator across desktop and mobile
feat(ui): spatial console overhaul, multi-dataset stack, mobile dock
Unpublished-product deep link now renders the primary product instead of failing closed
wrangler config lacks no_bundle/find_additional_modules; production 404 page server-renders empty

top_extraction_candidates.name: PlaybackView.client.vue decomposition
top_extraction_candidates.why: 2398-LOC single-file orchestrator is the largest maintainability risk in the app, though it is too domain-specific for a narduk-libs extraction.

top_extraction_candidates.name: LayerControlPanel.vue
top_extraction_candidates.why: Largest reusable-shaped control-panel pattern (select/slider/badge grouping with mobile companion state); a shared 'control panel section' primitive could shrink this.

notes: This app is a specialized raster/map playback viewer, not a CRUD/list app: no tables, no pagination, no search-filter bar, no narduk-libs dependency at all today (not even narduk-core). Its extraction value for the shared-table initiative is near zero; its extraction value for narduk-ui instruments (range/legend/readout shapes) is real but indirect. Onboarding this app to narduk-core/narduk-ui would itself be the bigger lift before any table work applies.
